verdict.rationale: The README's headline commands load and run GGUF-packaged models directly from Hugging Face, for both CLI chat (`llama cli -hf ...-GGUF`) and the server (`llama serve -hf ...-GGUF`). Community reports of running quantized models like Q6_K and Gemma-3 corroborate the run side, though they do not name GGUF. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation describing GGUF as the supported format, evidence of loading local GGUF files, independent reports naming GGUF specifically.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
